description.value:
If you are able to move and haven’t yet, you can spend your movement to instead do a hypnotizing dance or flourish for another creature within 60ft that can see you. That creature gains a bonus on their next check or attack roll equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Alternatively, this dance can silently convey a meaning that could be described with 5 or fewer words, regardless of language barrier.
This ability can be used 3 times per long rest.
